name_note: GTDB names this species Blautia_A fusiformis; most of its genomes carry the NCBI name Blautia massiliensis, the name used in the papers cited here.

sentences.text: Blautia massiliensis is a gut bacterium available commercially as a culture and studied for effects on cognition.
Mice gavaged with Blautia massiliensis for three weeks showed improved cognitive performance, while Blautia faecis impaired it, in one reported experiment.
That study reported Blautia massiliensis produces approximately six times more acetate than Blautia faecis and suppressed hippocampal neuroinflammatory responses.
Random forest analysis in a study of people in confined environments suggested Blautia massiliensis among characteristic microbes with diagnostic value.
A study of people recovered from mild COVID-19 reported Blautia massiliensis enriched three months after recovery.
